draft.emotion: a practical, everyday action of getting ready to start the day
notes: पहनना describes the action of putting clothes on, as well as habitual wearing. To say someone 'is wearing' something right now, Hindi uses the perfective/stative form (जैसे: उसने लाल साड़ी पहनी है or वह लाल साड़ी पहने हुए है), whereas पहन रही है means 'is putting on'.

draftBefore.emotion: a practical, everyday action of getting ready to start the day
notes: Use 'पहनना' both for the action of putting something on and the state of having it on. In English, you use two different verbs ('put on' vs 'wear'), but in Hindi, one verb covers both meanings.

This verb is transitive and usually requires the object (the clothes) to be marked with the postposition 'को' if it is a specific person or a very specific item, but generally, it is used directly with the clothing item as the object.
